productName: DocWatermarker — Instant Watermarks, Draft Stamps & Timestamps for Google Docs

shortVideo.fullText: Tired of stamping and removing draft watermarks across multi-page documents getting locked behind monthly subscriptions and external cloud portals? With DocWatermarker, One-Click Multi-Section Stamp & Purge runs right where you already work. Dynamic Date, Time & Author Tokens and Non-Destructive Layout & Table Preservation—100% under your own custody. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.

demoVideo.fullText: Need a better way to handle stamping and removing draft watermarks across multi-page documents, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord? Watch DocWatermarker in action: Apply or remove watermarks across 50-page, multi-section documents in a single click—no manual header-by-header editing required. Automatically stamp the exact version date, local timezone timestamp, or reviewer name so printed and exported PDFs never go stale. Plus, preserves your existing body margins, table pagination, and section breaks so removing a DRAFT notice never wrecks your final layout. Never upload confidential M&A drafts, legal agreements, or HR policies to external PDF watermarking websites. Everything runs inside your Google Doc. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
